mapper.select: SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, a.MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, ACCOUNT_PURPOSE AS account_purpose, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM tb_account a JOIN tb_bank_member m ON a.member_no = m.member_no WHERE m.LOGIN_ID = #{username} AND a.ACCOUNT_STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY OPENED_AT DESC

SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, ACCOUNT_PURPOSE AS account_purpose, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM tb_account WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS != 'CLOSED'

SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, ACCOUNT_PURPOSE AS account_purpose, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM tb_account WHERE ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (ACCOUNT_PURPOSE IS NULL OR ACCOUNT_PURPOSE NOT IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS'))
SELECT MIN(account_no) FROM TB_ACCOUNT WHERE member_no = #{member_no} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT MIN(account_no) FROM TB_ACCOUNT WHERE member_no = #{member_no} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (ACCOUNT_PURPOSE IS NULL OR ACCOUNT_PURPOSE NOT IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS'))

SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, ACCOUNT_PURPOSE AS account_purpose, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM TB_ACCOUNT WHERE member_no = #{member_no} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (ACCOUNT_PURPOSE IS NULL OR ACCOUNT_PURPOSE NOT IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS')) ORDER BY OPENED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: BEGIN INSERT INTO TB_ACCOUNT ( MEMBER_NO, ACCOUNT_ALIAS, BALANCE, ACCOUNT_STATUS, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, ACCOUNT_PURPOSE, OPENED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, #{accountAlias}, #{balance}, 'ACTIVE', #{accountPassword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountPurpose, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE ) RETURNING ACCOUNT_NO INTO #{accountNo, mode=OUT, jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=java.lang.Long}; END;

BEGIN INSERT INTO TB_ACCOUNT ( MEMBER_NO, ACCOUNT_ALIAS, BALANCE, ACCOUNT_STATUS, ACCOUNT_PASSWORD, ACCOUNT_PURPOSE, OPENED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, #{accountAlias}, #{balance}, 'ACTIVE', #{accountPassword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountPurpose, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE ) RETURNING ACCOUNT_NO INTO #{accountNo, mode=OUT, jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=java.lang.Long}; END;
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ACCOUNT SET balance = balance + (#{balance} + (#{balance} * (#{applied_interest_rate} / 100))) WHERE account_no = ( SELECT MIN(account_no) FROM TB_ACCOUNT WHERE member_no = #{member_no} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' )
UPDATE TB_ACCOUNT SET account_status = 'CLOSED', balance = 0, closed_at = SYSDATE, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE account_no = #{account_no}
